summary: Liberty Defense Holdings, Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026, along with management's discussion and analysis and CEO/CFO certifications. The filing is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a US quarterly report on Form 10-Q. It shows the company's financial position, including a deficit of $63.2 million, but does not announce any transaction, corporate action, or event that would classify it as a special situation. There is no mention of any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change beyond routine certifications. Accordingly, the filing does not trigger a special-situations classification.
